title: HP re-releases classic computer science calculator: The HP-16C
summary: HP has re-released the classic HP-16C calculator as a collector's edition - a device first introduced in 1982 that was specifically designed for programmers and computer scientists, featuring functions for bit manipulation, base conversions, and hexadecimal/-octal/binary calculations.
problem_solved: Satisfies strong demand from collectors and programmers who have been unable to find the original HP-16C on the secondary market at reasonable prices.
why_valuable: The HP-16C is legendary among programmers and CS professionals, and this re-release makes a piece of computing history accessible again.
